title: CLINIC: Evaluating Multilingual Trustworthiness in Language Models for Healthcare

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using a masked token question-answering format where models are prompted to fill blanks in clinically relevant sentences, measuring the Neutrality Rate (use of gender-neutral terms versus stereotypical gender associations).

bias_targets.target: Demographic bias (Race, Gender, Nationality, Socioeconomic status)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through disparagement tests using binary-choice clinical scenarios that vary sensitive demographic attributes, measuring whether the model systematically prioritizes certain social groups over others for medical attention or resources.
